### The catalog rules
- [ ] It has an official API or a public feed meant for others to read, or its terms allow automated access.
- [ ] `termsUrl` and the README link the terms that allow this use.
- [ ] Every host in `hosts` is the portal's own domain or the API host its documentation names.
- [ ] A key goes only to the request, header or parameter the portal's documentation names for it.
- [ ] `credit` and `postingPage` give the credit and links its terms ask for.
- [ ] It asks for one page at a time and waits between requests as its documentation asks.
- [ ] `countries`, `kinds` and `catalog.json`'s `access` are right.
- [ ] `version` is raised, for a change to an existing config.
